ai_assistant_panel.title: Assistente Deivid — Leitura e Resumos
features: Gerar resumo executivo dos chamados abertos
Agrupar principais falhas por sala ou equipamento

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, input, select, card, table row, badge, and tab MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Adhere strictly to the requested dark emerald/black theme without adding excessive messy glows or overly bright gradients.
2. Ensure 'grau Técnico' branding is highlighted on the public creation page and 'grau TI' is highlighted on the Admin top navigation.
3. Implement JWT/bcrypt admin authentication (accounts for Deivid and Bruno) with proper local token persistence and protected routes.
4. Make sure ticket status changes can be performed inline in the admin table and automatically produce an audit log entry recorded with user name, timestamp, and status change.
5. Ensure the archive functionality sets an archived flag rather than deleting data from the database.
6. Include the Deivid AI assistant component on both public and admin pages (for public: quick FAQ and ticket lookup; for admin: ticket summary and intelligent incident report).
7. Add toast notification feedback via 'sonner' for every form submission, login event, status update, and archive action.
8. Guarantee responsive layout for mobile and desktop viewports and add data-testid to all key interactive elements.
